## About
Lakewood Auto Care is a full service repair shop on E South St in Long Beach. Whether your car is foreign or domestic, our technicians are ASE certified and trained in specific repairs, and the shop is state certified for California smog inspections.
Mark, the owner, specializes in BMW work but services just about any make. Reviewers say he explains what your car needs and what it doesn't, and that he cares about keeping your vehicle safe. The shop holds a 4.3 rating on Google from 25 reviews.

## Services
- Smog checks: State certified smog inspections, plus repairs when your car has smog related issues.
- Headlights adjusted: California requires properly adjusted lamps. We know the light inspection and the steps to bring your vehicle up to standard.
- Brake service: One reviewer dropped off a car for brake service and got a call back with a diagnosis and price before work began.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign and domestic cars?
A: Yes. Whether your car is foreign or domestic, our technicians are trained in specific repairs.

Q: Can you fix problems that cause a failed smog check?
A: Yes. Along with smog inspections, we handle repairs for smog related issues.

Q: How do I schedule service?
A: Give us a call to schedule an appointment, no matter the make or model.
